looks.description: A small bipedal creature standing approximately seven inches tall that looks like a raw piece of chicken, featuring random pink-hued feathers, two tiny forearms instead of wings, a long serpentine tail, a beaked mouth revealing a row of sharp, tiny teeth, and beady, reptilian eyes.

A young velociraptor-like dinosaur with pink-hued feathers along its arms, grown longer and thicker and mixed with a line of deep red feathers, a tail that has grown longer and more dinosaur-like, and skin around its eyes that has taken on a bluish tone.
looks.change: Grown larger; red feather line, bluish eye skin.

looks.description: A velociraptor-like dinosaur now a hand taller than a nearby cat companion and about the size of an actual turkey, with pink-hued feathers along its arms mixed with a line of deep red feathers, a tail that has grown even longer with a set of long feathers sprouting from its back, skin around its eyes with a bluish tone, and a beak that has widened and grown larger.

A velociraptor-like dinosaur that has grown to nearly the waist height of an adult human, its body covered in colorful feathers (pink hues mixed with a line of deep red) and studded with long black spikes, with a tail carrying a set of long feathers sprouting from its back, skin around its eyes with a bluish tone, and a beak that has widened and grown larger.
looks.change: Waist-high; long black spikes (this scene only).

looks.description: A large, mastiff-sized velociraptor-like dinosaur covered in colorful feathers (pink hues mixed with a line of deep red). Its face is mostly the beak of an overgrown chicken; when the beak opens, a row of sharp, ripping teeth circles the interior, and little tendrils of electricity crackle from its mouth whenever it snaps its teeth. Skin around its eyes carries a bluish tone.
looks.change: Mastiff-sized; ring of teeth; electricity from mouth (this scene only).

looks.description: A large velociraptor-like dinosaur that has grown to the height of an adult's chest, now pony-sized rather than dog-sized. It is covered in colorful feathers (pink hues mixed with a line of deep red). Its face is mostly the beak of an overgrown chicken; when the beak opens, a row of sharp, ripping teeth circles the interior. Skin around its eyes carries a bluish tone.

A dinosaur-chicken-like creature, the height of a pony, coming up to just below shoulder height, about 13 feet long from the tip of its beak to the end of a colorful red-and-blue feathered tail (the tail making up more than half that total length), with claws on its feet now bigger than its entire body had been when first acquired.
looks.change: 13 feet long, red-and-blue tail, huge claws.

looks.description: A creature with a collar around its neck, bleeding from dozens of wounds across its body.
looks.change: Collar; bleeding from dozens of wounds (this scene only).

looks.description: A winged creature carrying a saddle on its back, with wings that flap up and down and a long tail sticking out of its stomach.
looks.change: Saddle and a tail sticking out of its stomach (this scene only).

looks.description: A dinosaur-like creature with little wings, blue and red feathers and a slight insinuation of youthful pink, wearing a crab costume that has fallen around its neck.
looks.change: Blue and red feathers, crab costume around neck (this scene only).

looks.description: A heavy dinosaur like a giant dog, with a large, heavy head, a beak, talons and a long feathered tail. His right wing is gone and the whole right side of his body is missing scales and feathers.
looks.change: Right wing gone; right side missing scales and feathers (this scene only).

looks.description: A large clockwork dinosaur with a long tail, wings that he waves, and feathers, including tail feathers that reach all the way to the back of a long truck, wearing a blue and gold striped pharaoh-style fabric hat (nemes) with floppy side bands.
looks.change: Clockwork body; pharaoh-style hat (this scene only).
